user_intent: Multi-tenant data isolation architecture visualized as Renaissance fortress and vault system technical illustration

subject.description: Three separate fortified vault structures drawn in architectural cross-section, each completely isolated with thick walls, moats, and independent foundations - no passages connecting them
Central fortified gatehouse with drawbridge mechanism that can only connect to one vault at a time, shown with detailed mechanical workings
Renaissance military engineering elements - bastions, curtain walls, and defensive ditches rendered in precise technical drawing style

scene.location: Aged vellum manuscript page with architectural grid and construction geometry visible beneath the drawing

artist_reference: Sebastien Le Prestre de Vauban fortification plans

video_prompt.narrative_concept: Three independent fortified vaults stand on separate foundations with no connecting passages, demonstrating architectural impossibility of breach

scenes.description: Bird's eye view descends toward a fortress complex showing three distinct fortified structures, each surrounded by its own moat, no bridges between them
scenes.motion: Camera descends slowly, revealing the complete separation
scenes.focal_point: The visible gaps and moats ensuring no connection

scenes.description: Cross-section view revealing each vault has independent foundations going deep into bedrock, separate water sources, self-contained supply systems - no underground tunnels connect them
scenes.motion: Camera moves through cutaway view showing depth of isolation
scenes.focal_point: The underground separation - foundations not touching

scenes.description: Return to surface view showing the central gatehouse that controls access, each vault door opening only to verified visitors through separate drawbridges
scenes.motion: Three drawbridges lower independently to three different authorized visitors

environment.setting: Vauban-style star fortress complex in cleared landscape
environment.lighting: Overcast diffuse light emphasizing architectural forms
environment.atmosphere: Still water in moats, flags on each tower, military precision

style.color_palette: Stone grey, moat blue, parchment cream, iron fixtures
style.texture: Dressed stone blocks, still water reflection, aged blueprint lines

motion_language.camera_movement: Descending bird's eye, transition to cross-section, return to surface
motion_language.subject_animation: Drawbridges lowering, flags waving gently, still moat water
motion_language.transition_style: Architectural diagram transitions - plan to section to elevation
